settings.question: How much does a man and van cost in Parramatta?
settings.answer: It depends on what you're moving, lifts or stairs at each end, the distance and timing. We give a fixed price before you book. Send your details or call 0469 717 535.

settings.question: Can you book the lift and loading dock for my apartment?
settings.answer: Building management usually books lifts and docks for residents. Book your slot, send us the time and any building rules, and we'll arrive ready to work within it.

settings.question: Can you move just one item in Parramatta?
settings.answer: Yes. Single items are a normal job for us: one couch, one bed or one fridge, with no minimum job size.

settings.question: Do you do same-day man and van jobs in Parramatta?
settings.answer: Often, yes. It depends on that day's schedule, so call or send your request early and we'll confirm.

settings.question: Can you pick up a Marketplace item and bring it to my Parramatta apartment?
settings.answer: Yes. Send us the listing and the seller's suburb. We arrange pickup with the seller and deliver it up to your unit.

settings.question: Is my furniture insured?
settings.answer: Yes. Your items are covered while they're in our care, and every piece is wrapped in blankets and strapped in the van.

settings.local_heading: Parramatta Moves Are Mostly Apartments. We Plan for That.
settings.local_body:
Parramatta has more apartments than almost anywhere outside the Sydney CBD, and most buildings have booked lifts, loading docks and strict time slots. Getting those details right before moving day is what keeps a job on time and on budget.

Tell us the building, lift and dock details when you book. We'll plan the arrival time, bring the right trolleys and protect the lift with blankets.
